hit_rate.definition: Share of answerable questions where a chunk from an expected source was retrieved

mrr.definition: Mean reciprocal rank of the first chunk from an expected source, over answerable questions

citation_rate.definition: Share of answers whose citations all name retrieved chunks, with at least one when answerable

judge_mean.definition: Mean 1 to 5 groundedness and correctness score from the judge model

latency_p95_seconds.definition: 95th percentile end-to-end agent turn latency, nearest rank
